source_prompt: A large vibrant green dog with red splotches and glowing orange eyes sits in a dark blue surreal room, mouth open as colorful red, green and gold ribbons and bubbles flow from its mouth. Black smoke billows from miniature oil derricks and factories built into its back. Behind it a mirror reflects a blue version of the dog. Shelves on the right hold glass jars containing small green dog-like specimens. A pink and red sky is visible through a broken ceiling, in a dystopian industrial nightmare style.
